title: Sales Planner, Off-Platform
searchText: Sales Planner, Off-Platform Instacart We're transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. Instacart is a Flex First team There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Overview Instacart is expanding rapidly, and we’re seeking a Sales Planner to join our Off‑Platform Sales team. This hire will assist in delivering customer‑centric solutions rooted in Instacart 1P data, partnering with Off‑Platform and Brand Partnership sales teams to win RFPs through architecting bespoke solutions, own delivery from launch through wrap, and identify and pitch incremental investment opportunities along the way. This role blends strategic planning with operational excellence to drive strong outcomes for our off‑platform advertisers. About The Role Pre‑sale Strategy and Planning Translate advertiser revenue-driving briefs into tailored media solutions: formats, audiences, measurement, and pricing Support audience planning; size, forecast, and pace inventory Build proposals and media plans, close deals, and execute IOs Assist in crafting compelling narratives that differentiate Instacart & ultimately lead to off-platform activations via our 1P data Identity & assist in pitching net-new whitespace revenue opportunities to help our advertising achieve their intended outcomes Campaign Execution and Performance Assist in launch-to-wrap execution: trafficking readiness, QA, pacing, optimizations, and budget delivery Coordinate cross‑functionally (Ad Ops, Analytics, Product, Creative, Legal, Finance) to unblock hurdles and activate with excellence Identify & pitch upsell opportunities throughout campaign lifecycle to increase revenue for Instacart, while driving outcomes for brands Manage portfolio revenue tracking, identifying whitespaces to drive focus for incremental revenue About You 4+ years in media or sales planning at an agency, publisher, or platform; strong grasp of programmatic, social, and video Excellent time management, organization, and communication skills Creative problem solver who thrives amid ambiguity Ability to tell a compelling story through data A self-starter with hunger to achieve goals Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here . Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please rea d more about our benefits offerings here . For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below. CA, NY, CT, NJ $97,000 — $119,000 USD WA $94,000 — $114,000 USD OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI $89,000 — $109,000 USD All other states $81,000 — $99,000 USD We're transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more... United States - Remote Ad Sales Remote - United States mobile-engineer Greenhouse
